Oliver —

Short answer: Dedicated for pilots that require predictable latency and isolation. A recommended starter pattern:

- Provision Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) with a single GPU pool sized for expected QPS (we'll size conservatively for pilot traffic).
- Use Private deployment only if customer requires strict VPC or on-prem constraints (adds ~2–4 weeks setup).
- Enable prefix/KV caching and low-latency routing to the nearest region; keep quantization conservative for the pilot to avoid quality regressions.

I'll include a one-page decision map in the follow-up that you can hand to customers. Also — Jonas and I will cover operational runbooks in the Wed session and provide a checklist your PM can use for handoff.

Thanks — see you Wed 09:00 PT.
